mapper.select: SELECT id, password, nickname, name, gender, birth, phone, email, profile_image_uuid AS image_uuid, profile_image_original AS image_original, profile_image_url AS image_url, personal_color, body_shape, created_at, updated_at FROM member WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member( id, password, nickname, name, gender, birth, phone, email, profile_image_uuid, profile_image_original, profile_image_url, personal_color, body_shape, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES( #{id}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{birth}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{image_uuid}, #{image_original}, #{image_url}, #{personal_color}, #{body_shape}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET nickname = #{nickname}, phone = #{phone}, personal_color = #{personal_color, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, body_shape = #{body_shape, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, profile_image_uuid = #{image_uuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, profile_image_original = #{image_original, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, profile_image_url = #{image_url, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id = #{id}
